policy: Five exact reviewed II-b successors replace eleven epoch-1 owner/display exceptions. New runtime pickers remain forbidden; entries may only shrink.

entries.source: transaction .select({ id: nodeRuns.id, seq: nodeRuns.seq, nodeId: nodeRuns.nodeId, shardKey: nodeRuns.shardKey, status: nodeRuns.status, rerunCause: nodeRuns.rerunCause, retryIndex: nodeRuns.attemptIndex, wgRound: nodeRuns.wgRound, envelopeNonce: nodeRuns.envelopeNonce, }) .from(nodeRuns) .where( and( eq(nodeRuns.taskId, taskId), eq(nodeRuns.recordMode, 'executable'), inArray(nodeRuns.nodeId, [WORKGROUP_TURN_LEADER_NODE_ID, WORKGROUP_TURN_MEMBER_NODE_ID]), ), ) .orderBy(asc(nodeRuns.seq))
